chunks: And with this chain of narration, from Sāliḥ, from al-Ḥarth ibn al-Mughīrah, from Abū ‘Abdillāh (peace be upon him), who said:

Indeed, Allāh has angels assigned to the grave of al-Ḥusayn (peace be upon him). When a man decides to visit him, Allāh gives his sins to these angels. With the first step he takes, they erase his sins; then with every additional step, they multiply his good deeds. His good deeds continue to increase until they entitle him to Paradise. Then the angels surround him and sanctify him, and they call out to the angels of the heavens: 'Sanctify the visitors of the Beloved of Allāh.' When the visitors perform ritual bath (Ghusl), Muḥammad (peace be upon him) calls out to them: 'O guests of Allāh! Rejoice, for you will accompany me in Paradise.' Then the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) calls out to them: 'I guarantee the fulfillment of your needs and the removal of affliction from you in this world and the Hereafter.' Then the Prophet (peace be upon him) joins them, staying to their right and left, until they return to their families.
ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual rewards and angelic interactions for someone visiting the grave of Imam al-Husayn?
ai.summary: In Kamil al-Ziyarat, Ibn Qulawayh narrates that angels actively erase sins and multiply good deeds with each step toward Imam al-Ḥusayn’s (a.s.) grave, a process that culminates in the Prophet (saw) and Imam ‘Alī (a.s.) personally welcoming the visitors. This tradition highlights the unique intercessory status of the Ahl al-Bayt, where their presence guarantees the fulfillment of needs and protection from affliction in both worlds, reinforcing the concept of spiritual merit through physical proximity to the Imams.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 3. My father narrated to me from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, and from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Muḥammad ibn Ḥusain, from Muḥammad ibn Ismā’īl, from Sāliḥ ibn ‘Uqbah, from Ḥarath ibn Mughīrah, who said:

Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said: Allāh has some angels who are dedicated to the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.). When someone decides to go to the Ziyārah of Ḥusain (a.s.), Allāh will give his sins to these angels. With the (first) step that he takes, the angels will erase his sins, and with any additional steps that he may take, the angels will multiply his good deeds, and his good deeds will keep increasing until he deserves (to enter) Paradise. Then the dedicated angels will surround him and sanctify him. They will call out to the angels of the heavens, “Sanctify the Zuwwār of the love of the love of Allāh (the Prophet (s.a.a.w.)).” After the Zuwwār perform Ghusl, Muḥammad (s.a.a.w.) will call out to them, “O guests of Allāh! Be delighted for you will join me in Paradise.” Then the Commander of the Believers (a.s.) will call out to them, “I guarantee the fulfillment of your requests and to keep the afflictions away from you in this life and in the Hereafter.” Then the Prophet (s.a.a.w.) will join them and stay to their right and left side until they return to their families.
